''See also: [[Eye of the Deep Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|The [[Eye]] of the Deep is a specialized artifact used to access the primary facilities within [[Ghostwater]]. Originally entrusted to the final Naru Huan{{!}}Blackflame Emperor by a [[Herald]] of the [[Monarch]], these objects function as keys that can be inserted into specific indentations to unlock sealed areas. Beyond their utility as keys, these jewels serve a broader purpose in gathering and recording information. They are scattered across the world to collect knowledge, which is eventually brought back to a central location to be added to a collective whole. Possessing an [[Eye]] of the Deep is highly significant; returning one to the tree allows a person to ask a single question and receive a drop of Ghostwater{{!}}ghostwater, an act that earns them a lifelong debt from [[Northstrider]]. Physically, the jewel can be damaged, such as by a whip, which may cause white-and-purple [[dream madra]] to leak from cracks in its surface.}}

== Ghostwater ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|The [[Eye]] of the Deep is a round, cut [[sapphire]] slightly larger than a fist that shimmers like sunlight filtered through [[water]] and casts a blue illumination. Carried by [[Renfei]], the jewel features white-and-purple [[dream madra]] and essence leaking from a crack caused by a damaged internal [[construct]]. This gem serves as the key to [[Ghostwater]] and can be used to deactivate a [[portal]], at one point projecting a blue light over an indentation in a [[stone tower]]. While [[Lindon]] eventually released the item, [[Dross]] is located within it, and the [[Eye]] of the Deep functions as a key to the facility. It is also noted that Akura Harmony{{!}}Harmony possesses an [[Eye]] of the Deep.}}
